question: Indicate the correct option regarding the defined daily dose of a medicine:

options.opa: Corresponds to the maximum daily dose.
options.opb: Corresponds to the initial dose of a treatment.
options.opc: Corresponds to the maintenance dose for the indication that requires a lower dose.
options.opd: Corresponds to the average daily maintenance dose.
options.ope: Corresponds to the initial dose for the main indication.
